_note: Product-level review of OMOP's AMT -> standard drug mappings (omop_drug), produced by scripts/omop_drug_audit.py and read by hand 23 Sep 2026. A 'rejected' mapping is moved aside by scripts/apply_omop_drug_review.py: the refused answer is kept in refused_standard_concept_id and the live standard_concept_id becomes NULL, so every reader (transcode, atc_bridge, drug_strength, amt_indirect) stops using it without code changes -- a rejected mapping is ignorance, not an answer.
_witnesses: Three, each independent of OMOP's product mapping: INGREDIENT (RxNav's resolution of the AMT active substances, never consulted OMOP), BRAND (the [brand] in OMOP's target name against the AMT product name), STRENGTH (strength_check: AMT's OWL strengths against OMOP DRUG_STRENGTH).

_kept_not_rejected.broadened: ferric carboxymaltose, ferric derisomaltose and iron polymaltose -> 'iron' (Ferinject, Monofer); lonapegsomatropin -> somatropin. Lossy, not wrong; kept.
_kept_not_rejected.omop_more_specific: doxorubicin -> Doxorubicin pegylated liposomal (Caelyx): OMOP right, RxNav's witness lossy.
_kept_not_rejected.two_concepts_one_ingredient: cromolyn/cromoglycate, ispaghula/psyllium, heparin/Heparin Sodium, thioctate/lipoic acid, racemethionine/methionine, vitamin E/alpha tocopherol: a witness artefact.
_kept_not_rejected.brand_spelling: Sandimmune, Voltarene, Verzenios, Endoxana, Gilotrif, Atconate (sic): European or US sister brands, ingredients verified.
_kept_not_rejected.for_a_person: trolamine -> trolamine salicylate (25), citric acid -> sodium citrate (5): plausible either way; not rejected.
